description: Searches conversations (threads) with the same Gmail query syntax as list_messages and returns id, snippet (of the latest message) and historyId per thread. Use this instead of list_messages when the unit of work is a conversation — triaging an inbox, finding a discussion to reply into. Filter with query and/or label_ids; paginate with page_token from nextPageToken (page_size max 500). Read the full conversation with get_thread.

include_spam_trash.description: Also search SPAM and TRASH (default false).

label_ids.description: Only threads carrying ALL of these label ids (see list_labels).

items.description: A label id from list_labels — system ids like "INBOX", "UNREAD", "STARRED", "SPAM", "TRASH" or a user label id like "Label_123".

query.description: Gmail query syntax, e.g. "from:amy@example.com is:unread newer_than:7d has:attachment subject:invoice". Same operators as the Gmail search box.

name: list_threads
title: Search and list threads
